## III. Proposed subpoena duces tecum — No. 1 (to Defendants as custodians)

**TO:** SPOUSES EFREN BALANE and GLORIA BALANE, SPOUSES JOMIL TORRALBA and PRINCESS BALANE TORRALBA, and ENGR. ERWIN BALANE, or whichever of them has custody, [address of record — VERIFY], through counsel of record.

**YOU ARE COMMANDED** to appear before this Court at ________ on ________, at ____ a.m./p.m., and to bring the following, if in your possession, custody or control:

1. The **originals** of every receipt marked as Defendants' Exhibit "5".
2. Any other receipt, in original, issued to any of you by or in the name of the "Heirs of Mary W. Keesey Estate", Cesar M. de la Fuente, or Salvador Osum dela Fuente, for the land in suit, from 1990 to 2021.
3. Any booklet, pad, cover, stub or duplicate in your possession from which any such receipt came.
4. Any notebook, list, ledger or other record kept by you of payments made for the land in suit.
